justification: HOLY COW folks, lookin' at this lineup card and I love every name on it! Aaron Rodgers slingin' it in Philly, D'Andre Swift runnin' wild for my Bears right there at RB1 -- that's a Chicago fella and don't you know it warms the heart -- Zay Flowers and Stefon Diggs out there catchin' footballs like they're born to it, Hockenson and Jones holdin' down the fort, Isaiah Likely ridin' that big 23-point outing right into my FLEX spot on pure vibes, and Boswell's been money since I plucked him off the wire. Jordan Addison's dinged up Out over in Minnesota but he's buried on my bench behind fellas already startin', so no harm no foul there, and Love, Bijan, and Hunter Henry are all restin' up on bye -- can't put 'em in the game if the stadium lights are off, folks! Everybody I'm trottin' out there is healthy, active, and ready to play ball against Coach Taylor's crew -- clear eyes, full hearts, let's play two!
forum_post: Well would ya look at that front page, Kris done it again -- 'held breath' is right, this whole league's quieter than a Sunday doubleheader rain delay! Me, I'm just three bucks and three straight losses deep but I ain't sweatin' it one lick -- got my Bear D'Andre Swift, got Rodgers slingin' it, got Likely comin' off a 23-point tape-measure game, holy cow this roster's ready to swing the bats! Coach Taylor, buddy, clear eyes, full hearts, let's play a heckuva ballgame out there Sunday -- may the best lineup win!
